rationale: Trade selectively: one entry per window (same-window trades are correlated), a high net-edge floor, a post-entry cooldown, and a daily cap. Frequency must be earned by marginal net edge, not maximized.
evidence_summary: marginal net P&L peaked at rank 1095/3135
1558 eligible candidates across 44 windows (=35.4/window); same-window trades are correlated (one label per window) — not independent samples.
unlimited entries/window net P&L (-3.115) did not beat max-1/window (1.909); extra within-window trades add risk without net benefit.
